title: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.28957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scanning every passage in a long document seems thorough, but does it preserve more useful evidence or produce better answers? We compare 11 retrieval configurations spanning lexical and dense search, hybrid reranking, and full-document scanning with Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and Cloudflare Clef. Our evaluation uses 396 QASPER questions and 80 questions from eight complete textbooks, with common passages, a five-passage limit, and a fixed answer generator. On books, Hybrid + Jev achieves the highest observed evidence coverage (94.1%), compared with 88.7% for Jev full scan and 81.3\% for OpenAI dense retrieval. Full scans examine every passage initially, yet later reduction steps can discard relevant evidence. Higher evidence coverage also does not consistently produce better answers: Hybrid + Decisions achieves the highest observed book Answer Accuracy among retrieval methods (0.892), despite recovering less reference evidence. translated_title: 扫描还是索引？长文档RAG中的证据覆盖率、答案质量与成本
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28957v1 公告类型：new 摘要：扫描长文档中的每一个段落看似彻底，但它是否保留了更多有用的证据或产生更好的答案？我们比较了11种检索配置，涵盖词法检索与稠密检索、混合重排序以及全文档扫描，涉及Jev、OpenAI Decisions和Cloudflare Clef。我们的评估使用396个QASPER问题和来自八本完整教科书的80个问题，采用相同段落集、五个段落的数量限制以及固定的答案生成器。在书籍数据上，Hybrid + Jev取得了最高的观测证据覆盖率（94.1%），相比之下Jev全扫描为88.7%，OpenAI稠密检索为81.3%。全扫描虽然最初会检查每一个段落，但后续的精简步骤可能会丢弃相关证据。更高的证据覆盖率也不一定能持续带来更好的答案：Hybrid + Decisions在检索方法中取得了最高的观测书籍答案准确率（0.892），尽管其恢复的参考证据较少。全扫描……
tldr: 该研究比较了11种长文档RAG检索配置，发现混合检索策略在证据覆盖率和答案准确率上均优于全文档扫描，且更高的证据覆盖率并不必然带来更好的答案质量。
en_tdlr: This study compares 11 retrieval configurations for long-document RAG, showing that hybrid retrieval outperforms full-document scanning in both evidence coverage and answer accuracy, and that higher evidence coverage does not consistently produce better answers.
